verdict: Yes. Taffykids pitched playful kidswear on Shark Tank India Season 4 and got a deal. Parents buy often and gifting is a steady extra market. Comfort and safe fabrics matter most; trends matter less than in adult fashion.
angle: Kids grow out of clothes every few months, so repeat purchases are frequent. Occasion wear for birthdays, festivals and weddings sells at better margins than basics. Keep batches small because you'll need many age sizes.
